feastLines.line: 🔥 The fire settles. Hassan has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Two knobs on glass-still water, watching — I put it down today." "It goes perfectly still. Only the eyes move. Then the water explodes — and the world starts spinning." "It has your leg. The roll starts. Do NOT let it reach the water." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. the woman in her 60s says "So it bleeds." Raj mutters "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Inas has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Living Wire — I put it down today." "The water goes glass-still. A faint crackling, and the hairs on your arms lift." "The crackling fades. It slides backward into the black water, done spending itself — for now." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nikolai says quietly "And you're still standing." Ella breathes "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

◈ RESONANCE HARMONICS — SYSTEM: "HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED. Objects with high observer-attention waveforms function as auxiliary capacitors. We call this RESONANCE HARMONICS. We do not know why the waveforms taste like grief. We have stopped asking." — Hold a keepsake. Think about them. The System will do the math. (It is not math. It is love. The System will never know.) Channel keepsakes from your pack.

🔥 The fire settles. Ella has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Anaconda Empress — I put it down today." "The water bulges — a ripple with intent." "It loosens, reluctantly, and pours itself back into the water. It will remember this pool." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Vivian breathes "The fire feels smaller now." Jaxon says "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

Frank says "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

"The whiskers go rigid — then lash." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Valeria breathes "We've been walking past those." Nikolai breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

Renato says quietly "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
